brief:
Israeli occupation forces established a military checkpoint northwest of Jerusalem on Sunday evening, according to Shehab Wire. The installation immediately restricted civilian movement in the area, as residents faced delays and disruptions to their transit routes.

The checkpoint was deployed as part of ongoing Israeli military operations that have repeatedly affected civilian access in occupied Jerusalem and surrounding zones. No details were provided regarding the checkpoint's stated purpose or expected duration.
